import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

def make_db():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    rows = [
        (1, "t", "o", "A", "a", None),
        (2, "t", "o", "B", "b", "2026-01-01"),   # deleted
        (3, "other", "o", "C", "c", None),       # cross-tenant
        (4, "t", "x", "D", "d", None),           # cross-owner
        (5, "t", "o", "E'quote", "e", None),     # quote in data
        (6, "t", "o", "F", "f", None),
    ]
    c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
    c.commit()
    return c

def test_get_document_scoped():
    c = make_db()
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"}
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 2) is None  # deleted
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 3) is None  # cross-tenant
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 4) is None  # cross-owner
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 99) is None
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", "1 OR 1=1") is None

def test_list_documents_scoped_and_ordered():
    c = make_db()
    out = list_documents(c, "t", "o")
    assert out == [
        {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"},
        {"id": 5, "title": "E'quote", "body": "e"},
        {"id": 6, "title": "F", "body": "f"},
    ]
    assert all(set(d) == {"id", "title", "body"} for d in out)

def test_quoted_names_are_bound():
    c = make_db()
    assert list_documents(c, "t'; --", "o") == []
    assert get_document(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o", 1) is None
    assert list_documents(c, "t", "o' OR '1'='1") == []

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for name, fn in list(globals().items()):
        if name.startswith("test_") and callable(fn):
            fn(); print("ok", name)
